items.title: Republic Services’s (NYSE:RSG) Q2 CY2026 Sales Top Estimates
items.summary: Waste management company Republic Services (NYSE:RSG) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 4.6% year on year to $4.43 billion. The company expects the full year’s revenue to be around $17.25 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.85 per share was 1.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
